{{Quote|Best post exchange around. You need it, we got it.|Anson greets a customer|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Anson''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] who could be found on the frozen and barren [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] during the time period known as the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. On the world, he made his living as a heavy [[Armor/Legends|armor]] vendor and [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]], selling items to the citizens of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He wore [[Color/Legends|white]] armor and carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Anson appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Heavy Armor Vendor for Republic players on Hoth.<ref name="TOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]], he was removed from the game along with the rest of the Heavy Armor Vendors.<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref>
